name: Abak
sourceReview: AkwaGIS is evidenced as the Akwa Ibom state land registry/GIS by first-party state and AkwaGIS pages. Its public page describes Land PIN or Plan/COD validation and parcel polygons in paid results, but no safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. This is registry evidence only, not source integration or admission.

queryOutcomes.english: Official AkwaGIS land-search, FAQ, about, and state homepage found; no public safe parcel geometry API found.
queryOutcomes.ibibio: No Ibibio-language first-party cadastral viewer/API found; results led to the same official service or general non-cadastral material.
queryOutcomes.viewerConfiguration: Current page JavaScript exposed /search/validate and /search/initiate browser route names but no usable anonymous parcel endpoint, schema, or CRS.
queryOutcomes.candidateApiRoutes: GET probes to /api/search/validate, /search/validate, /api/search/initiate, and /search/initiate returned 404 HTML responses.
queryOutcomes.geometry: No parcel geometry returned; no sample retained.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identifier only when stable and source-proven
uncertainty: AkwaGIS documents a state registry and polygon-capable paid search, but anonymous public geometry access and Abak-specific coverage were not demonstrated. The WUP point was not used as a parcel identifier and no absence conclusion was drawn.
